checks.test: const lbl = (el) => [...(el.labels || [])].map((l) => l.textContent).join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const fields = $$('input'); return fields.length === 4 && fields.every((f) => lbl(f).length > 0) && /full name/i.test(lbl($('#full-name'))) && /email/i.test(lbl($('#email'))) && /standing/i.test(lbl($('#t-standing'))) && /seated/i.test(lbl($('#t-seated')));

const radios = $$('input[type="radio"]'); const fs = radios[0] && radios[0].closest('fieldset'); if (!fs || !radios.every((r) => fs.contains(r))) return false; const lg = fs.querySelector('legend'); return !!lg && fs.firstElementChild === lg && /ticket type/i.test(lg.textContent);

const email = $('#email'); await input(email, 'samir.example.com'); await click('#pay'); if (email.getAttribute('aria-invalid') !== 'true') return false; const ids = (email.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); return ids.some((id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el && !el.hidden && /enter an email/i.test(el.textContent); });

const email = $('#email'); await input(email, 'samir@example.com'); await click('#pay'); if (email.getAttribute('aria-invalid') === 'true') return false; const ids = (email.getAttribute('aria-describedby') || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); return !ids.some((id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el && /enter an email/i.test(el.textContent) && !el.hidden; }) && $('#email-error').hidden;
